content: Is it possible to wire up Lean to frontend ? Either directly or through something like Vite that is not reliant on a brittle stdout pipe?

That can mean many different things, could you clarify the question?
Do you mean:

  • You want to build a website using Lean
  • You want to run the Lean kernel on the web for a web IDE
  • You want to see the infoview inside a browser because you're not using VSCode
  • You want to add JS widgets to Lean
Well, personally, I'd be interested in accessing the infoview other than through VSCode. I'm not especially attached to getting it in a browser.
Then check out #Editors & UIs > Lean-TUI (self-contained infoview) @ 💬 and #general > InfoView in a Web Browser? @ 💬
